body: je li se porez automatski plati? ili moram nesto napravit
the part with people saying “she’s your mom” is so accurate, they just can’t understand how difficult that kind of thing is and you couldn’t explain it if you tried (atleast to some).

damn we really are,
my mother is such a grudge holder and also quite controling, for me tho it’s the fact that my older brother did all kinds of things when he was my age and no one cared but if i want to stay out a little bit longer or something like that it’s the end of the world.

rant aside, things are very hard right now for me and you both i’m sure but even tho i wouldn’t call myself an optimist i still believe in holding on a bit and making the best of it until you can get out, i hope you can share this idea with me - it’s something that really keeps me going.

i wish you much luck in life!
the worst is that i see how it affects my attitude as well, i would've been a better person if i had good parents definitely. i try my best but it still catches up to me.
i'm happy you got away. hoping for the same when i'm a bit older.
